---
title: References to kept content
format:
  typst: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        shown: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "`@sec-gone` points to content that the group `advanced` removed"
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: "Unable to resolve crossref @sec-gone"
          count: 1
---
